narrative_flow.rationale: The clue-search objective and transition to people in the hallway were understandable, but delayed click response and an unlabeled close-up exit impeded exploration. Other bedroom objects were not explored before transition.

aesthetic_similarity.rationale: The same-session bedroom shares the reference camera angle, layout, palette, and furniture. The live image has a stark white exterior void, flatter material detail, and different lighting and shadow balance than the warm, textured reference.

action_sfx_integrity.rationale: The bed close-up shows the blanket displaced, while the sampled frames do not show hand contact; the detective reaches toward the door. Physical motion was only partially visible. SFX is not independently judged.

blocked_phases: Wardrobe and other bedroom objects were not examined before the door transition; initial clicks showed no immediate response.
